summary: Multidisciplinary Mechatronics Engineer with hands-on experience designing, fabricating, and commissioning complex industrial and R&D systems across mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, and control domains.

bullet_points.text: Designed, built, and integrated electrical, motion, and pneumatic subsystems for custom mechatronic equipment, including an IP69K-rated dynamic checkweigher.
Optimized client filling and capping lines through on-site equipment upgrades, commissioning, diagnostic troubleshooting, and technical support.
Architected and programmed PLC control systems, integrating motion control, distributed I/O, sensors, actuators, and industrial networks.
Machined and fabricated precision mechanical components, including a custom rocket motor.

link.display: SolarShape: Solar Concentrator for Industrial Processing (PRR-funded project)

children.text: Led cross-functional development of a solar concentration system for industrial process heat, taking mechanical, optical, and control subsystems from concept to prototype validation.
Designed complete electrical layouts and schematics in SkyCAD, executing full control panel assembly, wiring, signal verification, and commissioning.
Engineered machine control logic in CODESYS (Structured Text) with EtherCAT for real-time motion, integrated with an OPC UA enabled, Go-based vision processing service and web UI.
Engineered and validated a novel solar-powered 3D printer proof-of-concept, delivering concentrated solar thermal energy to the printhead via fiber optics.

bullet_points.text: Executed high strain-rate mechanical testing using a Split-Hopkinson Pressure Bar (SHPB), troubleshooting experimental setups and evaluating dynamic stress-strain material response.
Engineered high-speed DAQ systems using LabVIEW and NI hardware, capturing real-time signals from strain gauges and custom capacitive displacement sensors.
Commissioned, calibrated, and troubleshot instrumentation, sensors, and experimental test rigs under extreme cryogenic and high-temperature environments.
Supervised Master's students in experimental procedures, overseeing testing protocols, lab safety, and thesis documentation.

education.institution: Instituto Superior Técnico — University of Lisbon
education.dissertation_title: Development of an advanced concentrated solar collector for direct use of solar energy in industrial processes.

bullet_points.text: Engineered and validated a two-axis solar tracker combining predictive algorithms with OpenCV vision feedback for real-time motion control.
Engineered, integrated, and validated mechanical, optical, electrical, and motion-control hardware for a solar concentrator prototype.
Machined precision optical components—including paraboloid mirrors—and evaluated optical geometries to verify target flux uniformity.
Designed, fabricated, and assembled a 200 W solar-thermal demonstration prototype.
